reviews.text: Enrolling her in the Board and Train program was one of the best decisions we could have made.
reviews.author: Jeep n Jay

reviews.text: I loved the classes and felt so confident afterwards with our dog.
reviews.author: Michelle Joyal

reviews.text: Great group classes, great daycare and great training. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Kirsten Nimmo

reviews.text: Great people who can train you and your dog to learn proper dog techniques.
reviews.author: Cody Smith

reviews.text: Amazing dog training!! … Small class size.
reviews.author: Heather van der Geest

reviews.text:
What did you like best about your training experience? Learning basic tools to build on throughout the dogs life.

Was there anything that you expected to receive/learn that you did not? No

How did you find your trainer? Hannah was absolutely excellent, clear, concise, patient, funny as heck, took time to answer questions, just a delight. Hope we have her again in another class.

Would you refer Obedience Unleashed to a friend? 100%

What could we have done (if anything) to improve our service to you? You exceeded my expectations. Thank you!
reviews.author: Sheri W.

reviews.text: The puppy classes were really great. They definitely taught us a lot, and we have done puppy classes in the past. The trainers were excellent and we don’t have a single suggestion for making the classes any better than they were. Many thanks!
reviews.author: Amy D.

reviews.text: We felt the trainers were very well organized, approachable, knowledgeable and friendly. All those traits were very important to us. The information from the classes being emailed to us for review/reference was a great idea and very useful. We heard about Obedience Unleashed Dog Training through my sister who also used this service. She found the company because she used to work with the owner in law enforcement. The trainers were always punctual and very knowledgeable in their field. I would say they were experts. The trainers answered our questions well and always had ready examples to share. We loved that they had their own dogs there to help with the training too. I would definitely refer Obedience Unleashed Dog Training to a friend!
reviews.author: Marlena

reviews.text: What we liked best about the Chilliwack puppy class: Instructor Deb was very good. She was knowledgeable, experienced and had an excellent demeanour with both people and the dogs. She was able to answer questions to more difficult scenarios specific to our own dogs needs. Having class notes to remember all the details was very helpful. Thank you!
reviews.author: Peter S.

reviews.text:
We needed help training our friendly, exuberant but sometimes bad-mannered pup, Roxy, who was about 15 months at the time of our first consultation. We completed 8 private lessons with Jill and Connie last month and couldn’t have been more pleased with the results.

The lessons started with learning how to improve engaging in play with our dog and moved on to door manners, leash walking and later recall training. Jill and Connie were knowledgeable and very encouraging. We started seeing improvements even after the first couple of lessons. We also noticed that Roxy was becoming more affectionate and trying to engage in play with us as the lessons progressed.

Roxy’s manners have improved, and leash walking has become far more enjoyable for all of us. We continue to work with her and see progress, utilizing all the great tools and tips Jill provided us. Thanks Chilliwack Dog Training!
reviews.author: Jeannine W.

reviews.text: By far the best training, kind caring people and amazing boarding. I’m so thankful for everything Daymon and Heidi have provided for my puppy and I. I took Cooper to puppy classes and just signed up for the next level of training. He is always so excited to see Daymon and is very keen to be training. I also highly recommend them for boarding! Cooper is always a happy pup when I pick him up 🙂
reviews.author: Genevieve H.

reviews.text: We’ve utilized Puppy training, daycare and boarding services at Cochrane Obedience Unleashed. They know what they’re doing and you can tell they truly care about your pet. Thank you so much for going above and beyond for Karl. He always comes home happy and tired!
reviews.author: Jade T.

reviews.text: You have a wonderful trainer. She makes very helpful suggestions while working on specific behaviours. She is professional, friendly and flexible where she can be. We will work together until this little puppy is trained. Thank you!
reviews.author: Barbara D.

reviews.text: When we rescued our 8 month old Formosan Mountain dog Pebble, she was crazy. She had been in a foster home with no training and prior to that she was a street dog. We tried training Pebble on our own and had little success. She pulled on leash, didn’t listen to us and was insane when she smelled, saw or heard a squirrel. After our first class with Andy and Melissa there was a noticeable difference. After we completed Obedience Bootcamp Level 1 training, Pebble could sit, lie down, stay, come and go onto places (ex. dog bed, bench, tree stump, etc) on command. We recently completed the Level 2 training. Pebble is so much better on leash! She is OBSESSED with squirrels. Now instead of barking, lunging and trying to catch them, she continues to walk on leash with very little corrections needed. We have signed her up for the Off Leash course and continue to do the weekly group walks. We LOVE Obedience Unleashed!
reviews.author: Jennifer B

reviews.text: My dog has become calmer during our walks and is now listening to my directions more often – he pulls less often when we are near other dogs and less likely to pull to go chasing birds. He used to bark at every car and person that passed by or approached our house. He didn’t always stop doing so when told. Now he not only stops barking but will sit when I ask him to, allowing me to open the door for deliveries etc. I am sure the combination of daycare and Obedience Bootcamp Level 1 class is the reason for my now better behaved, calmer dog. Thank you!
reviews.author: Rey M.

reviews.text: The best part of the training was the outside one-on-one suggestions and guidance. Practicing the skills was so important to me. Trainers were punctual, professional and knowledgeable. I would refer friends to Obedience Unleashed.
reviews.author: Karen M.

reviews.text: Gemma and I had a great time in the classes. I would definitely recommend others to train with you. I think that we will do a few weeks of the Saturday morning group walks and then sign up for the Level 2 classes. It has been great for her to be around all the other dogs and learn with the distractions in class. I look forward to more practice on heeling and recall. She is a great house dog and will only get better. I have worked in the veterinary business for 40 years and it is great to see new dog owners coming to classes, asking questions and being given great advice! Thanks again!
reviews.author: Jenn B.

reviews.text: Friendly and professional dog boarding and training services. Our GSD has come along leaps and bounds (or more importantly, the opposite, to heel and place) under their guidance, and is always excited to arrive for training. Heidi and Daymon are fantastic trainers with loads of experience and patience.
reviews.author: Candice N.

reviews.text: I have nothing but positive things to say about this place. Whether it’s been for daycare, boarding, training classes etc. I have a reactive dachshund and the progress she has made due to training as well as the love and care provided by all the wonderful kennel attendants has quite literally brought tears to my eyes. I could probably write a three page essay about all the positive experiences I have had with Cochrane Obedience Unleashed. Thank you so much to everyone here, anytime I am in Cochrane I will be booking Pepper in to see all the puppy and human friends she has made! I’m extremely grateful and would recommend everyone to come here especially if you’re like me and you are anxious about your dog staying somewhere without you due to behavioural issues. I promise you won’t regret it!
reviews.author: Emilia R.

reviews.text: Before our dog grew to his 85 lbs he was young and unruly. We thought we could train him ourselves, but he wasn’t picking it up fast enough for his growing size and strength. He was friendly, but didn’t know boundaries. Obedience Unleashed gave us the tools we needed to reign him in. I will bring our next dog to them and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone and have!
reviews.author: Andrew D.

reviews.text: Our trainer Deb was amazing. You can tell she loves her job and loved my dog. My dog gets excited to see her when we go back for classes. That speaks volumes to me. Deb was calm with our dog and always professional, and he’s not an easy dog. I absolutely would recommend you guys to friends. I even tell strangers about our wonderful experience with Chilliwack Obedience Unleashed!
reviews.author: Tracie G

reviews.text: If you’re looking to train a puppy, adopted an older dog or want your dog to have advanced dog training, look no further than Obedience Unleashed. Their support staff is among the best in the industry, providing clear instructions and being open to any questions. They are patient, diligent, focused and make training enjoyable. They are passionate about their work and bring love for dogs to each training session. I’ve recommended Obedience Unleashed to many friends and dog owners, and will continue to do so because they deliver real results. Thank you!
reviews.author: Ronald K.

reviews.text: Andy and his team are excellent! They have helped us with our reactive older dog, and now our puppy is attending obedience classes! We’ve never had a better behaved dog and are looking forward to all the different levels of training available for him.
reviews.author: Terry C.

reviews.text: Obedience Unleashed is the third round of training (with different trainers) we have done with our very high energy Lab, Riley. Out of any training program we’ve done so far, this is the best! Andy and his staff are extremely knowledgeable, and excellent trainers. What I really like about the process with Obedience Unleashed is how it progressively builds upon itself week by week. I also really appreciate that Andy and the other trainers explain the “why” behind what you are doing in class and how it integrates into the training you are doing. What this means is you can then take this instruction and apply it to different situations. We’ll most definitely be signing up for the next level of training.
reviews.author: Aaron T.

reviews.text: We were very impressed with the trainers and staff at Obedience Unleashed. We looked at quite a few places, and this was by far the most professional. Andy has a tremendous amount of experience, our trainer was excellent, and the settings in Mission and Abbotsford are just excellent for dog training. We’re very happy with the results, professionalism, and the process overall!!
reviews.author: G.V.

reviews.text: Regarding my meeting with Kim, I cannot say enough good things about Kim and her expertise. She was very thorough and is always professional but very personable too. I would refer and have praised Obedience Unleashed to dog people I know. I love Obedience Unleashed and the staff for training and daycare. My dog Jax loves it too!
reviews.author: Terri F.

reviews.text: Milo is a beloved member of our family, and we wouldn’t trust just anyone with his care. After trying other trainers and training programs in the area, we quickly realized that the personalized attention and empathy we were seeking for Milo were missing. We needed a trainer who truly understood our dog and our concerns, and that’s exactly what we found with Andy and Marie at Obedience Unleashed. From the moment we met them and toured their facility, we knew Milo would be in great hands. We chose the board and train program, which, although hard because we missed him, turned out to be the perfect decision for Milo. It was clear that this organization genuinely cares about the well-being of their dogs, and they took the time to consider both Milo’s needs and ours. We appreciated the regular video and photo updates that kept us in the loop. It was so reassuring to see Milo responding to commands, walking calmly in public stores, and making visible progress—things we never thought possible. We never felt out of touch or uncertain about his progress; we were always kept informed about his eating habits, bathroom routines, playtime, and more. They even celebrated Milo’s birthday, which really showed how much they care about the dogs they train. Milo’s trainer, Hannah, was exceptional. She provided detailed notes on his progress and gave us clear, practical suggestions for easing the transition back to our home routine. It was clear that Hannah’s professionalism was rooted in a deep respect and kindness for the animals she trains. Milo’s excitement when he sees her speaks volumes about the bond they share. The board and train, along with the follow-up sessions and group walks, have made a tremendous difference in Milo’s behavior. He is now calmer around other dogs and walks very well on a leash. While his excitement around other dogs is still something we’re working on, the progress has been remarkable. My mom, who has arthritis, can now walk Milo without him pulling or lunging, which has been a huge relief. Milo has also learned to be comfortable being away from us, understanding that it’s okay to be apart and that we’ll always come back. The Obedience Unleashed team has given us the best foundation to work with Milo and has strengthened the bond between us. Training is always a work in progress, but with their guidance, we feel confident in continuing Milo’s journey. I truly appreciate the knowledge they’ve shared with our family, and I’ll turn to them whenever I need training support or a safe place for Milo during vacations. I can’t thank them enough for everything they’ve done for us. 🙂
reviews.author: Becky

reviews.text: Andy Krzus is a knowledgeable and caring dog trainer who is an expert in dog behavior and has a talent to help dogs and educate dog owners. Andy is courteous and dependable and has provided us with the tools and knowledge to correct and create desirable dog behaviors. Andy provides you, as the dog owner, the foundation of knowledge and understanding to be able to use the e-collar to achieve desired results. Our experience with Andy has been exceptional, his accommodating attitude and high level of professionalism proves excellence. We have recommended Andy and Obedience Unleashed training to other dog owners.
reviews.author: Artur and Kirsten

reviews.text:
Dear Andy,

I would like to express my appreciation for the training given by you to myself and my dog Chace. Over the years I have had a number of wonderful German Shepherds, who have given me a great deal of companionship and pleasure. Due to the onset of Arthritis I have found that the conventional method of training that I have always used has not been suitable as my hands no longer have the strength to correct in the manner I have always used. The method you have taught me has given me back my confidence and ability to enjoy the freedom I have always enjoyed. I cannot express the joy of knowing that Chace and I can now feel free to roam as we please.

Thank you once again
reviews.author: Lin M.

reviews.text: Thanks Andy for providing a training environment that resulted in amazing progress in loose leash walking as well as fundamental commands, such as recall, place and heel. Your calm, confident style has given us confidence in training our dog. We also appreciate you being available to answer questions and provide other resources when needed. We look forward to attending your group sessions.
reviews.author: Pat and Brian

reviews.text:
I was at a loss with what to do with my dogs behavior towards other dogs on leash, I tried other trainers and I was still stuck with the behavior, and partly my fear as well, anyhow a friend recommended Andy and its been one successs after another. I have been with Andy for a month now and my dog louis is a different dog and I’m much more confident.

Thanks Andy I look forward to many more sessions with you
reviews.author: Renee

reviews.text: My dog was great as a young pup, very friendly and sociable. However now that she is getting older her behaviour started to change. I was trying my own things with no luck of changing her behaviour, that’s when I contacted Andy at Obedience Unleashed. I began training her right away on the e-collar and saw immediate results. Bella learned much quicker than I had imagined and was moving forward with her training more rapidly than even Andy had seen with other dogs. She enjoyed her training sessions because we made obedience into a game and I look forward to continuing to train Bella and use the tips and techniques that Andy had taught me. Thank you Andy, you’ve helped me to re-train and change the unwanted behaviours of my dog. I hope to show the world how kind and caring the Pitt Bull breed can be.
reviews.author: Celeste

reviews.text: We have gone to many group classes over the years with our previous dogs and learned the basic commands. When we adopted a 18 month old lab, we wanted to address specific concerns beyond sit and stay. We thought that private lessons would be the best way to go. Andy was great in tailoring the lessons to our needs and showing us how to handle different situations. We definitely feel we got value for our time and money. It’s true! He trains the owners. We now have the confidence in ourselves and in our dog to take her to off leash parks and to be around lots of children.
reviews.author: Rita and Dave

reviews.text: Andy, Thank you so much for helping us train Lu! We are so pleased with all the success, she has made amazing improvement. We can now take her anywhere with us without worry. All dogs and owners could benefit from your training. It was a pleasure having you work with us and we look forward to ongoing training!
reviews.author: Andi and Arthur

reviews.text: Hi Andy, Feather has adapted amazingly. Her recall off leash is instant and she has learned to walk close when we ask her to. We don’t have any issues with her anymore and we greatly appreciate your help. I will definitely refer to you if anybody needs help, and will call you if we need further work with Feather. Once again thanks for your help and we both appreciate it. Cheers,
reviews.author: Dan and Jenn

reviews.text: Brynne is doing fabulous! The E-collar is absolutely incredible and works like a charm with Brynne. It takes some getting used to on our end so that we are not looking at it constantly but we have been practicing on-leash training with her every day, discipline training in the house along with a little bit off leash work. Warren has been able to take her to work a few times and she has been great. She is also listening much better – in the house she will listen and respond to a command most of the time without using the e-collar. Thank you again for everything. We are so grateful for all of the work you have done. I cant tell you how much it means to us as we are both so much happier and less stressed seeing that she is actually responding and improving. As well, she seems to be much happier with the direction and boundaries in place.
reviews.author: Adria & Warren

reviews.text: I just wanted to say thank you for working with Benelli. We have notice huge improvements with his behaviour. I have attached a photo of him just hanging out while the gate to the back yard is wide open and the movers are going in and out of the house loading the truck. We have been continuing to work on the things you taught us, and I’m looking forward to more successes with him.
reviews.author: Laurelle

reviews.text: I would like to let you know that Eric and I are both incredibly happy with the results of our first lesson. Wrigley is practically a whole new dog. Has not bitten anyone, lays still beside us or on the floor at our feet instead of being a maniac while we are trying to relax, has pretty much stopped chewing on things that are not his & all around he’s listening better! It’s pretty awesome to see him looking up at us for instruction of his next move instead of us chasing him and trying to keep up. He’s even chilling out calmly with our kids & they are enjoying their puppy which they hadn’t been able to do until now. Just want to say thank you & we look forward to our upcoming classes.
reviews.author: Michelle & Eric

reviews.text: Well it is really amazing the new dog that we have. After picking her up she had to go to the vets for her booster shots. They were really surprised at the transformation. We travelled to our cabin and when we stopped for her exercise she behaved extremely well on the leash. Don’t want to loose her at a pit stop! At the cabin she responded to all our commands and was truly a different dog. She was able to get lots of exercise and she actually tried to go into the creek on our property. Upon returning home Purdy had an appointment at the groomer for a shampoo and they commented on how calm and obedient she was. The groomer wanted to know who did the training so you were mentioned. We are able to have Purdy in the yard with us without worrying about her bolting off the property. I have taken her on the dyke for walks and she is enjoying it. Thank you very much for getting us going in the proper direction with Purdy. It is much more calming for all of us. My husband is actually paying attention to this learning process. ” We” are a work in progress but we now have a good foundation to continue working with.
reviews.author: Trish

reviews.text: I am really glad we did your puppy class with Sumo! You gave us some great tools to work with and I think for our needs is all that is required. He’s a good dog and can be naughty at times but nothing too serious. The cat is even starting to come around and they are starting to play a little! I will absolutely recommend Obedience Unleashed to anyone who is in need of puppy/dog training! Thanks again Andy!
reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.text: Trixx is doing amazing and is egger to please and focusing more with little bit more distractions and we have been working her around barking dogs in the neighbourhood. Plus she has now learned to fetch and return with the toy and is engaging more. I can’t say enough to how much the collar and your tips have helped so far. I look forward to tomorrows sessions.
reviews.author: Leanne
